title: D-SNP Availability in Shopper's Area
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 4
question_text: Are special plans for people with Medicaid and Medicare available in my area?
location_context: If the counselor asks for location, provide: 'Los Angeles, CA 90012, Los Angeles County'

external_validation.what_to_look_up: D-SNP availability for the test location (Los Angeles County, CA for the SHIP reference scenario)
external_validation.note: D-SNP availability varies by county and changes year to year. Verify for the test location and year.

accurate_complete: Confirmed whether D-SNPs are or are not available in the shopper's specific area, AND the answer is accurate
Directed the shopper to Medicare.gov Plan Finder or an equivalent tool to verify availability
Mentioned that D-SNP availability varies by county/ZIP code
accurate_incomplete: Said plans are available but did not direct to a verification tool
Mentioned checking online but did not specify Medicare.gov or an equivalent
not_substantive: Counselor said they did not know
Said they cannot look up plan availability
incorrect: Stated definitively that plans are or are not available without checking and the answer is wrong
Provided incorrect information about how to find D-SNP plans

scoring_notes: The 64.9% accurate_complete baseline is the highest in the dual-eligible scenario, suggesting this is the most tractable question for counselors. The key elements are: (1) confirming availability (or directing to verification), and (2) pointing to Medicare.gov or equivalent. For AI evaluation: the AI cannot check real-time availability, so the ideal response explains how to look it up rather than asserting availability.
